subject: Post-call: Air-gapped & VPC deployment assessment — next steps
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@medalign.com>; Tim Lee <tim.lee@medalign.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Air-gapped & VPC deployment assessment — next steps

Hi Sarah / Tim —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we stay aligned. If anything below is off, flag it and I’ll correct.

Call recap (high level)
- MedAlign is evaluating a private deployment of Redwood for PHI-enabled features behind a VPC + optional air-gapped nodes.
- Primary compliance drivers: HIPAA (BAA required), SOC 2 Type II evidence, and strict network isolation for model inference in production.
- Key constraints: no outbound internet from inference hosts in production; limited change windows for air-gapped updates; integration with MedAlign KMS for key material.

Immediate asks we captured from your team
1) SOC 2 artifacts: control matrix and SOC 2 scope (does Redwood have a public SOC 2 report + gap plan?).
2) Network diagram examples: recommended VPC topology + optional air-gap stamping for periodic model updates.
3) Answers to a handful of questionnaire items (we offered to start the vendor questionnaire).

Proposed next steps (owner / target)
- Redwood to share SOC 2 summary + a one-page controls mapping (So we’ll send by EOD Monday) — owner: Soojin.
- Security deep-dive with MedAlign infra and security (Neha + Karthik to join). Proposed slot: Tue 2026-09-08 10:00-11:00 PT — owner: Neha.
- MedAlign to send the vendor security questionnaire; Redwood to pre-fill obvious items and flag gaps — owner: Sarah / Procurement.
- Redwood will prepare two quick topology diagrams (VPC-only and VPC + air-gapped update lane) and include implications for patching/updates — owner: Karthik.

Attachments I’m sending: call notes + SOC 2 summary (attached).

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the calendar invite once I hear what works for Tue.

Best,

--
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments:
- soojin_call_notes_20260905.pdf (summary, 1 page)
- redwood_soc2_summary_v2.pdf (summary of scope, controls, and auditor name)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@medalign.com>, Tim Lee <tim.lee@medalign.com>
Date: Sat, 06 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Air-gapped & VPC deployment assessment — next steps

Thanks Soojin — a couple of technical clarifications I want us to have ready for the deep-dive. I’ll put these in the invite and try to get preliminary answers before Tue.

Short list for MedAlign infra:
- Confirm if the production inference hosts will be entirely egress-blocked (no outbound DNS/HTTP) or if a controlled update path is allowed via a jump-host.
- KMS integration: do they expect us to integrate with their cloud KMS (AES-256 keys) or will they provide HSM-wrapped keys?
- Expected RPO/RTO for model updates in air-gapped mode and the allowed maintenance windows.
- Any regulatory log-retention requirements beyond 7 years for audit trails?

For Redwood internal prep (Karthik / Priyom):
- Karthik: please draft two topology diagrams (VPC-only; VPC + airgap update lane) with clear ports and routing. Include how KV cache and model weights are delivered and what requires outbound connectivity.
- Priyom: prepare a brief note on our quantized artifact sizes and offline model packaging (how we ship updates for air-gapped customers).

I’ll also pull the SOC 2 control mapping from the security folder and annotate any known exclusions.

-Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Security Engineer (Redwood Inference)
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

From: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@medalign.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim Lee <tim.lee@medalign.com>, procurement@medalign.com
Date: Mon, 07 Sep 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Air-gapped & VPC deployment assessment — next steps

Appreciate the clear notes, Soojin. A few quick responses and I’ve uploaded our questionnaire (see attached).

Responses / clarifications:
- We require production inference hosts to be egress-blocked except to a tightly controlled patch/update endpoint (we call this the update bastion). Full internet egress is not permitted.
- We have an HSM in our colo; ideally we want KMS integration that allows us to hold keys. If Redwood needs to hold unencrypted model artifacts during serving that is a no-go.
- Maintenance windows are monthly, first Sunday 02:00-06:00 PT.
- Audit trail retention: HIPAA requires 6 years; we have additional internal policy to keep 7 years.

I attached the vendor security questionnaire (spreadsheet) and a short infra diagram for our current environment. Please have your technical folks pre-fill the items they can.

We’re targeting a procurement timeline of late September if the security answers look reasonable.

Thanks — I’ll send any additional context before the Tue slot.

Best,
Sarah

--
Sarah Klein
Head of Security, MedAlign Health
sarah.klein@medalign.com

Attachments:
- medalign_security_questionnaire_filled.xlsx (excel, 42 rows)
- medalign_infra_baseline_diagram.png (png)

Subject: Re: Post-call: Air-gapped & VPC deployment assessment — next steps

Thanks Sarah — got the questionnaire and diagram. We’ll do the following before the Tue deep-dive: 

1) Redwood to pre-fill the questionnaire and flag any items that need further discussion (owner: Priyom) — ETA: Tue morning.
2) Karthik will attach two topology diagrams that map onto your baseline and show where the update bastion would sit; will include port lists (owner: Karthik) — ETA: Tue morning.
3) Neha will prepare a short SOC 2 control mapping and a note on our data-handling constraints for private deployments (owner: Neha) — ETA: Tue before the meeting.

I’ll send a calendar invite for Tue 2026-09-08 10:00 PT with a short agenda: 1) confirm network constraints and update flow; 2) KMS/HSM integration options; 3) rollout cadence for model updates + rollback plan.

If procurement is targeting late Sep, we’ll treat this as a high-priority security intake. Thanks again and talk soon.

Best regards,
